proof.text: Apply homology to the finite free coefficient complex square. Exactness of tilde and chart restriction gives the natural mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso comparison. Compose this square with naturality of extendHomologyIso to identify integer m homology with natural m homology. The private generic homology_coefficient_square is proved by mapping the initial square, and composing these three commuting squares. Specialize it to the dual Koszul complexes and their coefficient reduction. The restriction limits instance is Scheme.Modules.preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor, imported from QuasicoherentKernel; its colimit preservation is the restriction adjunction instance. The natural homology comparison is Functor.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso from PreservesQuasiIso, and the extension comparison is Mathlib extendHomologyIso_hom_naturality.

title: Homology transport of the affine Koszul coefficient square

lean.statement:
theorem affine_koszul_hom_coefficient_homology_square
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) (I : Ideal (Γ(Y, U.1)))
    (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (H : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ℤ ⥤
      CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ℤ)
    (hH : H =
      let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
      let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
      let E := (T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A n f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      (homComplexFunctor (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj (op E)) :
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules 0
    let D := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ)
    let G := S ⋙ H ⋙ D
    ∃ (cO : G.obj (T.obj (ModuleCat.of A A)) ≅
        T.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualComplex A n f).homology m))
      (cQ : G.obj (T.obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) ≅
        T.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulQuotientDualComplex A I n f).homology m)),
      G.map (T.map (ModuleCat.ofHom I.mkQ)) ≫ cQ.hom = cO.hom ≫ T.map
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulCoefficientReduction A I n f) m)

statement: For any affine chart U of a scheme Y [def-pc-scheme], ideal I of A=Γ(Y,U), and sequence f:Fin n → A, the finite free Hom coefficient complex square [lem-sc-affine-koszul-hom-coefficient-complex-square] induces isomorphisms on degree m homology to T of the natural-degree dual Koszul homologies [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex, new-j3-koszul-quotient-coefficient-complex]. They intertwine the coefficient quotient map with T of the homology map of koszulCoefficientReduction. Here T is tilde followed by chart transport [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], H is the specified Hom functor [def-pur-hom-complex] with equality hH, and m is any natural number. No closed immersion or adjunction coefficient map is involved.
